notes:
Background: Midridge builds a product analytics toolkit with an in-app assistant and doc search for product managers and PMMs. Evaluated Redwood Hosted API for 30d POC; now sizing Dedicated.

POC highlights / metrics (hosted trial):
- Duration: 30 days (2026-02-01 to 2026-03-02).
- User surface: ~3,200 monthly active users on pilot; typical day ~1200 MAU.
- Traffic profile (observed): avg QPS: 12 sustained; peak QPS: 42 (observed during 11:00-13:00 PT product demos).
- Concurrency observed: 75 concurrent open websocket streams during peak demo window.
- Token profile (per request averages): input avg 180 tokens, output avg 240 tokens -> total ~420 tokens per interaction.
- Token mix: ~60% short (<64 tokens responses - quick FAQ), ~30% medium (64-512 tokens - summaries), ~10% long (>512 tokens - deep pulls).
- Latency: median 120ms for streaming first token; tail p95 ~420ms (hosted). For embeddings batch jobs p95 tokenized batch time ~2.6s (per 1k vectors).
- Cost notes: Hosted trial spend ~$5.4k for month under trial traffic profile. They simulated daily growth to 2x in pricing scenarios.

POC technical notes / requirements: 
- Primary need: predictable tail latency for in-app assistant (p95 target <400ms).
- Throughput target for Dedicated sizing: sustained QPS target 20 with headroom for 3x burst to 60 QPS.
- Concurrency target: support 150 simultaneous user chats with streaming.
- Embedding pipeline: nightly bulk updates ~200k docs -> expects to run batched embedding jobs over off-peak windows (prefer cheaper quantized faster workers).
- Model preferences: prefer open Llama-style variants + Redwood-verified performance profiles. Want ability to route to smaller cheaper variant for short responses.
- Routing/fallback: must have automatic fallback to smaller model when Dedicated is at capacity; prefer region-aware routing (NA primary, EU for EEA customers).
- Caching: heavy potential for prefix/KV caching on product help content; estimate 35% hit rate if implemented.

Security / compliance: 
- SOC2 compliance required for production; SSO/SAML mandatory; KMS for key management; audit logging required for regulatory customers in EU.
- Data residency: EEA customer docs must remain in EU region — they will require Redwood Private or dedicated region routing for EU tenants.

Dedicated sizing proposal discussed: 
- Baseline pool: 4x A100-equivalent workers (estimated) to meet 20 QPS sustained with streaming and 150 concurrent sessions; allows p95 targets.
- Burst capacity: autoscale to 12 workers for 60 QPS peaks (budget permitting).
- Embedding workers: 1 dedicated lower-cost worker reserved for nightly batches (quantized path).
- Cache layer recommended: enable prefix KV cache + short-response routing to low-latency small model to reduce token spend ~18-25%.
- Estimated committed monthly spend scenarios provided in pricing deck (linked).

Customer quotes / signal: 
- "We like the predictability of Dedicated — want to move off hosted when we have committed spend visibility." — Director of Engineering.
- Product lead: "Major blocker is security sign-off and how KMS will be integrated with our current vault."

Next steps (short):
- Team to finalize QPS/concurrency targets (they to confirm by 2026-03-18).
- Redwood to produce final Dedicated sizing with pricing tiers and SLOs (deliver by 2026-03-20).
- Schedule procurement call and exec pricing review week of 2026-03-23.
